name: ZEM-24NF
description: ZEM-24NF was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was among the Skytrooper forces deployed to board Darth Marr's flagship during a battle with the Eternal Fleet in 3636 BBY. Equipped with CryoBan grenades, the droid was destroyed in battle with an enemy combatant.
